about: The shared colour palette (tools/blender/README.md §Palette). Every hero, gear, weapon and part mesh carries COLOR_0 = (slot / 15, region / 15, 0, 1) per vertex: the client's toon material reads the slot and looks the colour up in a per-character palette of 16 entries, so one material and one draw call serve the whole assembled hero. `preview` holds the colours the review renders use; the game supplies real ones (species skin tones, class colours, the grade's trim, the element).

slots.name: skin2
slots.note: a second skin tone: lips, Draconid belly and throat, Orc and Halfling detail

slots.name: ink
slots.note: pupils, mouth line, deep recesses, straps' shadow lines

slots.name: trim
slots.note: rims and studs, coloured by the item's grade (F grey … God white-gold)

slots.name: bone
slots.note: horns, claws, tusks, teeth, nails, bone fittings

slots.name: cloth3
slots.note: a third cloth: linings, sashes, tabards' charge
